Model card: Decision-2.0-Eos-0.8B · Core ML vllm-sr/Decision-2.0-Eos-0.8B (vLLM Semantic Router, Apache-2.0) converted to Core ML for on-device use on Apple silicon. Decision 2.0 answers Choice, Yes/No and Score questions about one input, with a probability for every option and no text generation. This port answers **every question of a request in one model call**. The text all the questions share (the context) is read once, and each question then continues from it as if it were alone. Eos uses a Qwen3.5 hybrid backbone (Gated DeltaNet + attention), so "continues from it" covers the DeltaNet recurrent state and conv history as well as the attention keys.
